en.headline: Man found dead in Cheung Sha Wan flat, woman taken to hospital
en.dek: Police said security staff at One Madison on Castle Peak Road reported an unusual smell at about 5:20pm, and firefighters forced entry.
body: Police and firefighters were called on Tuesday afternoon to a flat at One Madison, 305 Castle Peak Road in Cheung Sha Wan, after security staff reported an unusual smell and said the occupants had not been seen for some time.

The force said the report came in at about 5:20pm. Firefighters forced the door. A man in his eighties was certified dead at the scene. A woman in her seventies was conscious and was taken to Caritas Medical Centre.

Local reports said the man was found in the bathroom and the woman in the kitchen area, and that the two were understood to be a couple. Police said they were investigating the relationship and the circumstances. No cause of death has been given.

zh.headline: 長沙灣單位老翁證實死亡 七旬女子送明愛
zh.dek: 警方稱青山道305號One Madison保安下午約5時20分報案，指單位傳出異味且住戶多時未露面，消防其後破門。
body: 長沙灣青山道305號住宅大廈One Madison一個單位，星期二下午約5時20分由保安報案，指單位傳出異味，住戶亦多時未有露面。
警方表示，消防破門進入後，一名八旬男子經檢查證實在現場死亡；一名七旬女子仍有意識，被送往明愛醫院治理。
本地報道指，男子在浴室、女子在廚房位置被發現，兩人據了解為夫婦。警方正調查兩人關係及事件經過，暫未公布死因。
